messages:
anya: idea: run a "gratitude pass" next week 1 -- basically a tiny token and 1-line note passed between teammates at desks. super small, 2-3 minutes each. who wants to coordinate route + packs?
colin: I can map the route for HQ pods. prefer lunchtime 12:30-1:30 so folks are around. need final list + desk numbers by Mon EOD.
frank: i'll own the token packs (seeded bookmark + sticker + note). can we keep contents identical for remote sends?
people-ops-bot: Reminder: spot award payroll entries need to be submitted 4 business days before payday. Check taxable thresholds per policy.
anya: good call. frank pls list per-recipient award amounts in the sheet so payroll can QA.
frank: default amount is $60 this round, exceptions flagged in column I. I'll assemble ~30 HQ packs + 10 remote.
bella: I'll handle remote shipping and scan tracking. need addresses and "ship_or_pickup" preference by Tue noon.
colin: route volunteers: colin north pod, anya south pod, bella remote ship, frank pack lead. can someone volunteer for quick photos? optional only with consent.
anya: I'll do photos but will ask for consent each time. keep it optional and private.
people-ops-bot: FYI: awards over $100 are taxable; please mark any manager-approved exceptions for payroll.
frank: packing checklist for assembly team:
```
- verify name + desk location
- include 1-line reason card (pre-printed + signer)
- include bookmark + sticker + protective sleeve
- add small 'no-photo' tag if requested
- place in labeled envelope
```
bella: shipping plan: domestic via USPS priority, EU via partner courier, APAC local express. will post courier matrix once addresses are in.
colin: quick script for passers: "congrats — we're giving you a tiny token for [reason]. no need to stop, just a quick hello and smile". keep under 60s.
anya: sheet link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1GratitudePass-Kits (fill cols G: pickup_preference, H: photo_consent, I: award_amount)
frank: budget note: keeping it under $200 total. frank will submit receipts to finance; please flag any expedited shipping for approval.
bella: i'll export tracking CSV after sends and post it in this thread.
people-ops-bot: Payroll export reminder: ensure employee IDs included for import. Deadline Tue 9am PT for next payroll cycle.
anya: final actions: 1) anya finalize recipients Mon 11am, 2) frank assemble packs Mon afternoon, 3) bella prepare shipping labels Tue AM, 4) colin run HQ pass Tue 12:30pm.
colin: confirmed. will DM anyone who is WFH during slot to arrange pickup.
anya: keeping this quiet and human. thanks all :heart:
